title: Drag & Drop API
definition: HTML5 Drag and Drop (DnD) allows users to click and hold an object, drag it to another location, and drop it.
simpleExplanation: It's the native browser system for moving elements around. You make an element draggable by setting `draggable="true"`. Then you use JavaScript events to track when it's picked up, when it hovers over a 'drop zone', and when it's finally dropped.
realWorldExample: Trello boards. You click a task card, drag it across the screen, and drop it into a new column.

basic: What HTML attribute makes an element draggable?
intermediate: Why do you need to call `event.preventDefault()` in the `ondragover` event?

answers.question: Why prevent default?
answers.answer: By default, browsers do not allow elements to be dropped inside other elements. If you don't call `preventDefault()` when dragging over a drop zone, the drop action will be cancelled.
